schema:name: Audit & Compliance Engine
schema:description:
The Audit & Compliance Engine is a component that records and monitors all activities and transactions within the health information network for security and regulatory compliance. It generates non-repudiable logs of who accessed which data and when to ensure full accountability across the ecosystem.

Its purpose is to ensure the security and integrity of health data by providing a traceable record of system usage and data access events. It supports governance by identifying potential breaches or unauthorized access through continuous oversight of the technical environment.

Example: A backend service that logs every instance of a clinician viewing a patient's sensitive medical history or personal data.
